documents.text:
Seller: Mavuno Crest Coffee, Kenya
Buyer: Liora Venn, France
Order: single-origin coffee beans

Requirements:
- Supply 10 kg of whole-bean coffee from Nyeri, Kenya.
- Pack the coffee in ten sealed 1 kg bags.
- Include a roast-date label on every bag.
- Include a printed brewing guide in the parcel.

Agreed price: EUR 240, including shipping.
Payment method: PayPal.
The buyer confirmed the requirements before payment. The coffee is intended for retail sampling, so the bags should remain sealed during transport. The seller will dispatch the parcel to the delivery details supplied privately by the buyer.

documents.text:
Monthly bookkeeping order form
Seller: Nara, independent bookkeeper, Indonesia
Buyer: Iven, owner of fictional shop Lumafern
Service month: April
Agreed fee: INR 12,000, payable through PayPal

Agreed deliverables, one requirement per line:
Prepare an April income and expense summary.
Reconcile the April bank statement against the bookkeeping ledger.
Provide an April aged receivables report.
Categorize all 20 April expense entries.

The buyer will provide the source records needed for the work. Deliverables will be sent electronically after preparation. This order covers the April service month only; any additional work requires a separate agreement.

documents.title: Agreed SEO audit scope
documents.text:
SEO audit order form
Seller: Toma Aderi, Nigeria
Buyer: Neri Vaso
Project: Organic search review for the buyer's catalogue website
Fee: JPY 42,000, payable through PayPal
Agreed deliverables:
Provide a crawl summary covering broken internal links.
Provide a list of ten priority page titles to revise.
Provide a competitor keyword gap table.
Provide a mobile usability review of the checkout flow.
The audit is advisory; implementation is not included. Deliver the materials as files, with any review notes included in the handover. The buyer will provide access to the catalogue site and identify the checkout entry point. Toma and Neri confirmed this scope before work began.

documents.title: Audit handover note
documents.text:
Handover from Toma to Neri
The audit package is ready. The files and included contents are listed below so you can find each part without opening every file.
- crawl-summary.txt: crawl summary covering broken internal links, with affected URLs and suggested fixes.
- title-priorities.txt: list of ten priority page titles to revise, with proposed replacements.
- checkout-review.pdf: mobile usability review of the checkout flow; the PDF is not reproduced in this handover.
The competitor keyword gap table is not included. I ran out of time before completing it and have not sent it separately. Please review the other materials and let me know whether you would like to discuss a revised date for the table.

documents.title: Post-delivery chat
documents.text:
Neri, 10:12: Thanks, I received the three files listed in your note. I can see the broken-link summary and the ten title recommendations.
Toma, 10:18: Glad those opened. The checkout review is in the PDF listed in the handover.
Neri, 10:26: I haven't opened that PDF yet. I'll look at it after our catalogue meeting.
Neri, 10:29: I also noticed the competitor table was missing. When can you send it?
Toma, 10:35: I haven't sent the table. I can propose a new date tomorrow, but I need to check my workload first.
Neri, 10:40: Please do. We agreed on that table, so I want to settle the timing before we close the project.

Website build quote, accepted by buyer
Seller: Kavya, independent web designer in India
Buyer: Neel, owner of fictional shop Mithi Nest

Agreed requirements:
Build a five-page website: Home, About, Products, FAQ and Contact.
Add a WhatsApp inquiry button on every page.
Provide a mobile performance report for the finished website.
Enter all 20 buyer-supplied product descriptions on the Products page.

Buyer will supply the text and product descriptions. Seller will hand over the finished site files and a short note. Any work outside these four requirements needs a separate agreement. Neel accepted this scope and the price before work began; payment is for the service, not for physical goods.

documents.text:
PROJECT BRIEF
Seller: Nali Visuals, Kenya
Buyer: Tavi
Project: One YouTube video about balcony gardening
Agreed fee: INR 18,000

Agreed deliverables:
- Deliver one finished video in 1080p MP4 format.
- Add English subtitles throughout the finished video.
- Use only music licensed for commercial YouTube use.
- Provide a separate YouTube thumbnail image.

Tavi approved this brief before editing began. Nali Visuals will deliver the files electronically. The fee covers the listed deliverables and one round of corrections to those deliverables. Any additional edits or formats require a separate agreement.

documents.title: Delivery handover
documents.text:
HANDOVER NOTE
From: Nali Visuals
To: Tavi
Project: Balcony gardening video

Delivered files:
- balcony-final.mp4 — finished video, 1920 × 1080, MP4.
- balcony-thumbnail.png — separate YouTube thumbnail image.

The MP4 contains the completed edit and music. English subtitles are embedded for the introduction and first two sections; subtitles for the final section are not included. The thumbnail is supplied as a separate image rather than embedded in the video.

The music licensing record was placed in a separate folder, but that folder is not included with this handover note. Please review the files and send any corrections covered by the agreed round.

Project: The Moon Kite, a children's picture book
Seller: Lira Malinaw, illustrator, Philippines
Buyer: Nao Fushimi
Service fee: JPY 84,000, payable through PayPal
Agreed scope:
Create four full-color illustrations of the fox protagonist.
Provide a front-cover illustration with space reserved for the title.
Deliver three spot illustrations of woodland objects.
Provide a black-and-white coloring-page version of the fox.
The illustrations are for a short print run and a digital edition. Final files will be supplied electronically, with the cover and interior art in separate folders. Both parties approved this scope before work began.

documents.title: Illustration handover note
documents.text:
From: Lira Malinaw
To: Nao Fushimi
Project: The Moon Kite
I have uploaded the final handover folders and sent you access to them. The interior folder contains four full-color fox illustrations: Fox at Dawn, Fox by the Stream, Fox on the Hill, and Fox Under the Moon. The cover folder contains the front-cover illustration with space reserved for the title. The spot-art folder contains two woodland object illustrations: a pine cone and a mushroom. No third spot illustration is included. The handover contains no black-and-white coloring-page version of the fox. Please check the files at your convenience.
